MapProperties.MapDescription: Ember Circuit. Three-lane racing for one to eight players.
MapProperties.Author: RealmArcade
MapProperties.LoadingBodyText: In the garage, press X to preview the next car. Use J, K, or L to fit one workshop part. Choose one part for free, or press its key again to remove it. The race director chooses the number of laps with Z and starts the countdown with C. Hold A or D to steer. Hold both to brake before a turn. The car drifts more under boost. Use Q on a straight and ease back onto the track if you hit dirt. Aim for the center stripes on each of the four jump ramps. Posts mark the two cliff edges. If you fall, you return to the last checkpoint. Blue arrows recharge your boost. Orange crosses slow you down. Choose a lane in a row of crystals and press E to use its power. Trailing racers have better odds of strong powers. Winterlock freezes unshielded rivals for 5 seconds. Ember mines give four drops, one per press of E. For a targeted attack, press F to select a rival, then E to fire. Damage slows your car, even under boost. At zero integrity you can still drive. Look for coins on the inside of bends and on the dirt shoulders. Press R to restore 10 points of integrity for 3 coins.
MapProperties.HowToPlayObjective: Choose your car on the grid and complete 1, 2, 3, or 5 laps.

Units.Name: Ember
Units.Description: Balanced handling and predictable corner exits.

Units.Name: Needle
Units.Description: Recovers grip quickly when countersteering. Accelerates more slowly.

Units.Name: Mastodon
Units.Description: Settles faster after jumps and resists slowing hits. Recovers grip more slowly.

Units.Name: Race Coin
Units.Description: Collect 3 coins to repair 10 points of chassis integrity.

Abilities.Name: Choose rival
Abilities.Description: Cycle through the other racers. Press E to fire at the selected rival.

Abilities.Name: Crystal power
Abilities.Description: Press E to use your crystal. Choose a rival with F for targeted powers. Each Ember mine uses 25% of the power bar.

Abilities.Name: Lightning
Abilities.Description: [X] Lightning — Deals 80 damage within a radius of 2.

Abilities.Name: Ember Drive
Abilities.Description: Boost for two seconds. Recharge on a blue arrow or by following a rival closely for 1.5 seconds.

Abilities.Name: Steer Left
Abilities.Description: Hold A to turn left. Release to keep your heading.

Abilities.Name: Steer Right
Abilities.Description: Hold D to turn right. Release to keep your heading.

Abilities.Name: Steer Left Stop
Abilities.Description: Stop steering chariot to the left.

Abilities.Name: Steer Right Stop
Abilities.Description: Stop steering chariot to the right.

Abilities.Name: Laps
Abilities.Description: Choose a race distance of 1, 2, 3, or 5 laps.

Abilities.Name: Change Car
Abilities.Description: Preview the next car on the starting grid.

Abilities.Name: Start Race
Abilities.Description: Close the garage and start the five-second countdown.

Abilities.Name: Scout Axle
Abilities.Description: Recover grip 8% sooner when countersteering (10% maximum versus stock Ember). Acceleration is 5% lower. Select again to remove.

Abilities.Name: Stoneguard Plating
Abilities.Description: Slowing hits last 20% less (25% maximum reduction versus stock Ember). Acceleration is 6% lower. Select again to remove.

Abilities.Name: Reinforced Suspension
Abilities.Description: Dirt costs 40% of speed instead of 48%. Settle faster after jumps. Turn-in takes 10% longer on pavement. Select again to remove.

Abilities.Name: Repair Chassis
Abilities.Description: Spend 3 race coins to restore 10 points of chassis integrity, up to 100.
